missions.title: Preference policy

protocol: Download and extract the workspace. Read README.md and candidate.py; predict the baseline before editing.

python3 -m py_compile candidate.py harness.py
python3 -m unittest -v test_candidate.CandidateContracts.test_preference_direction
python3 harness.py --track posttrain --seed 17 --output posttrain-17.json
Use development runs for tuning. Freeze the candidate hash, then repeat with seeds 113, 271 and 811. Do not keep tuning against those results.
Change preference noise and beta separately; report accuracy and divergence, including a setting that fails.
deliverables: Candidate source, harness and exact invocation
JSON reports with source hash, runtime and metrics
One plot with per-seed points, baseline and ablation; 1-page failure analysis
evaluation: The harness checks a small controlled problem. Inspect each failed check; keep failed runs.
Report mean and spread, never only the best seed. Import the JSON to record evidence; independent review is still required.
A fixed seed set is reproducible, not a secret test set. Ask a peer to choose fresh seeds and altered conditions.

Read the candidate function contracts. Start with a tiny CPU smoke run, debug one failing gate, then run the larger configuration.

First reproduce your scalar MLP gradients with PyTorch autograd; assert gradient parity and tensor shapes, overfit 32 examples, and test train/eval mode and checkpoint round trips. Then translate the attention and masked-loss drills into tensor operations.
Create a pinned Python/PyTorch environment; record pip freeze, git SHA, accelerator and all config files. Begin with a 100-batch CPU smoke before any GPU run.
Generate disjoint train/validation/test operand tuples. Hold out carry patterns and longer digit lengths; do not split duplicate strings at random.
Implement causal masking, token shift and loss masking. Overfit 32 examples first; compare sampled outputs against exact arithmetic.
Freeze SFT checkpoint. Generate preference pairs only from training prompts. Run DPO and a TRL GRPO baseline with equal sampled-token budgets; report effective KL, reward and response length.
deliverables: Training entrypoint and evaluator, checkpoint, dataset generator and locked split hashes
Loss and held-out exact-match curves; SFT/DPO/GRPO comparison at equal compute
At least three seed runs, reward parsing tests and a reward-hacking example
evaluation: Reject leakage, incorrect masking or train-only improvements. Derive one objective and verify its gradient numerically.
A peer reruns the baseline and one improvement from a clean environment; record differences.
Toy arithmetic is a bridge to post-training research, not evidence of capability on general language tasks.

Progress gate: three passing full reports from the same source and evaluator on distinct seeds, findings, artifact, and a recorded independent review. Smoke reports alone never finish this project. Imported JSON is user-supplied evidence, not authenticated proof.

runtime.coverage: Executable scope: a small numeric-input, single-answer-token transformer; real SFT, DPO and GRPO updates. Multi-token language modeling and a TRL reproduction remain research extensions.

missions.title: PPO from scratch in a real simulator
missions.objective: Implement PPO with batched environments, GAE, clipped policy loss, value loss and entropy; reproduce a known small-control baseline.
protocol: Executable gate: select Mac CPU and pair the local runner; alternatively download the workspace and use its README. python evaluate.py --assessment ppo-control --seed 17 --scope smoke --candidate candidate.py --output result.json
Translate the scalar MLP into PyTorch tensors and autograd, verify gradient parity, and fit synthetic observations before introducing a changing policy distribution.
Use a version-pinned Gymnasium CartPole then a continuous-control environment. Record wrappers, truncation semantics and observation normalization.
Implement rollout buffer and update loop without copying trainer internals. Compare each tensor on a fixed rollout against an independent implementation.
Run 5 training seeds and at least 20 evaluation episodes per seed. Compare random, reference PPO and your PPO at equal environment-step budgets.
Ablate advantage normalization and clipping independently. Plot learning curves with seed-level uncertainty, not episode samples treated as independent training runs.
deliverables: Runnable trainer, resume checkpoint and fixed-rollout tests
Raw trajectories, configs, 5-seed comparison and two ablations
Diagnosis of one unstable run with hypothesis and counter-experiment
evaluation: Test terminal vs truncated bootstrap, stale log-probs and minibatch shuffling.
Before declaring reproduction define an acceptance interval from the baseline distribution and compute budget.
Peer changes horizon or reward scale during a 90-minute debug session.

Progress gate: three passing full reports from the same source and evaluator on distinct seeds, findings, artifact, and a recorded independent review. Smoke reports alone never finish this project. Imported JSON is user-supplied evidence, not authenticated proof.

runtime.coverage: Executable scope: real PPO training in a custom multi-step point-navigation simulator. The next gym-ppo mission reproduces PPO in Gymnasium; distributed training remains a research extension.

missions.title: Reproduce PPO in Gymnasium CartPole
missions.objective: Implement and train a PyTorch actor–critic with PPO in the established CartPole-v1 environment. Reproduce learning across fixed seeds, inspect failed runs, and prove deterministic checkpoint resume on your own CPU.
protocol: Executable gate: select Mac CPU and pair the local runner; alternatively download the workspace and use its README. python evaluate.py --assessment gym-ppo --seed 17 --scope smoke --candidate candidate.py --output result.json
Read the CartPole environment and PPO paper. Predict which episode endings should bootstrap and write down the random-policy baseline expectation before running.
Complete the policy, GAE and clipped-objective TODOs in candidate.py. Start with the CPU smoke scope; inspect value and gradient checks before interpreting returns.

Freeze source and training config, then run full scope on seeds 17, 29 and 43. Keep all per-seed reports, immutable configs, candidate snapshots, learning curves and checkpoints. Evaluation episodes never enter optimization or checkpoint selection.
Interrupt after seven updates and resume the checkpoint. Compare the full learning curve, model, optimizer and RNG states with an uninterrupted run. Preserve the evidence from both.

Plot per-seed learning curves and compare final policies against their paired random baselines. Propose one ablation before running it; keep compute fixed and declare fresh evaluation seeds before a final review.
deliverables: Candidate source, pinned runtime, immutable configuration and source/evaluator/runtime hashes
Three full per-seed reports, raw training curves, held-out episode returns and random baseline; aggregate mean and seed-level spread
Resumable model/optimizer/environment/RNG checkpoint plus deterministic-resume comparison
One-page analysis of clipping, truncation, seed variability and the limits of CartPole evidence
evaluation: Objective and gradient parity, trained policy-output changes, held-out score and random-baseline improvement must pass the versioned manifest criteria.
Use seed-level variation for replication analysis; repeated episodes are not independent training runs. A three-seed normal interval is descriptive, not a robust confidence claim.
A reviewer reruns one fixed candidate and checkpoint from a clean pinned environment and examines one failure or predeclared ablation.
This bounded small-control reproduction does not establish PPO performance on the paper’s full benchmark suite. MPS cannot pass until backend parity is implemented and checked.

Progress gate: three passing full reports from the same source and evaluator on distinct seeds, findings, artifact, and a recorded independent review. Smoke reports alone never finish this project. Imported JSON is user-supplied evidence, not authenticated proof.

runtime.coverage: Executable scope: real PyTorch PPO training in pinned Gymnasium CartPole-v1 on your CPU. Includes held-out episodes, a paired random baseline, three-seed reports, hashed configs and exact deterministic checkpoint resume. MPS is explicitly unsupported pending parity validation; larger control benchmarks remain research extensions.

missions.title: A useful upstream contribution

Write a design note: baseline, hypothesis, compute cap, failure cases, acceptance test and cheapest falsifying experiment.
Build the smallest patch with tests and exact reproduction commands. Run a clean-environment replication before opening the PR.

evaluation: A merged PR is useful adoption evidence, not a universal qualification. Judge scope, correctness and ownership.
Research readiness additionally requires an original, well-controlled finding and an independent reviewer who can challenge it.
If results are null, document the informative negative result honestly.
